artifact_schema.description: A 2-colouring of the complete graph on 17 vertices, as a symmetric 17x17 matrix of 0/1 colour bits with a zero diagonal. edges[i][j] is the colour of the edge between i and j.

example.edges: a 17x17 array of 0/1, symmetric, zero on the diagonal

edges.description: 17 rows of 17 integers, each 0 or 1. Must be symmetric with edges[i][i] = 0.

statement: Exhibit a 2-colouring of the edges of K_17 containing no monochromatic K_4 in either colour. R(4,4) = 18, so 17 is the largest complete graph where this is possible and such a colouring exists -- this is a witness to a known bound, not an open question. All 2380 four-subsets are checked, so acceptance is a complete proof rather than a sample. Pass or fail: there is no score to push, which is the honest shape for a question answered by a witness instead of a frontier.
